notes.title: Devs & Kids
notes.notes: Join us for an exciting live event as developers showcase their skills in a thrilling NaronaSports showdown! Watch as they engage in intense matches, share insights, and discuss the intricacies of game development. Don't miss the chance to witness the action-packed competition and get an exclusive peek into the world of NaronaSports development. Get ready for a gaming experience like never before!
